:aantal webhooks van afnemers staan uit: :aantal reseller webhooks are disabled after too many failed attempts.
Alleen klantaccounts. Een account dat in: Customer accounts only. An account that logs in to the CMS cannot be a reseller, because an API key bypasses two-factor authentication.
Alleen nodig voor een eigen developer. E: Only needed for your own developer. A new key is created; existing keys keep working.
Bijvoorbeeld de afnemer zelf, of zijn we: For example the reseller themselves, or their web developer.
Bijvoorbeeld de omgeving of de koppelpar: For example the environment or the integration partner, so you can find it later.
Dat gebeurt op de achtergrond en duurt e: This happens in the background and takes a few minutes. "Last updated" shows when they are done.
Deel deze links met niemand: wie ze heef: Do not share these links with anyone: whoever has them can see your purchase prices. If you think a link has leaked, let us know and we will create a new one.
De feeds worden nu op de achtergrond aan: The feeds are now being created in the background. If the reseller fetches their link before they are ready, they are asked to try again shortly.
The email could not be sent.
De nachtelijke afstemming van de afnemer: The nightly reconciliation of the reseller catalog has not run in the last 26 hours. Check the scheduler.
De oude links werken meteen niet meer. D: The old links stop working immediately. The reseller must put the new link in Matrixify or WP All Import.
De volledige API staat op :url. Stuur de: The full API is at :url. Send this link to your developer or integration partner.
Een account dat in het CMS inlogt kan ge: An account that logs in to the CMS cannot be a reseller.
Een koppeling die deze sleutel gebruikt: An integration using this key loses access immediately.
Een product in het assortiment van de af: A product in the reseller's assortment is new or changed: price, stock, text or images.
Een product is niet meer beschikbaar voo: A product is no longer available to the reseller.
Een product zit in het assortiment als h: A product is in the assortment if it falls in one of these categories or product groups, or was chosen individually. A category includes everything below it. Only public products of the site count.
Elke aanroep van een afnemerssleutel, me: Every call made with a reseller key, with path, status and duration. Default: 30 days.
Elk publiek product van de site zit erin: Every public product of the site is included, also products added later. Exclusions still apply.
Ga in Matrixify naar Import en kies bij: In Matrixify, go to Import and choose "From URL" as the source.
Ga naar All Import, Settings, en zet \"F: Go to All Import, Settings, and set "File Download Time Limit" to 60 seconds.
Geen prijsgroep: deze afnemer krijgt de: No price group: this reseller gets the consumer price as purchase price. Set a price group under Price groups.
Hernoemen wij een product bij ons, dan v: If we rename a product on our side, the link (Handle) to it changes and Matrixify creates a new product; the old one then stays next to the new one.
The old secret stops working immediately. The reseller must enter the new secret in their integration.
Het resultaat staat zo onder Webhook-bez: The result will appear under Webhook deliveries shortly.
In het bestand staat onze adviesprijs in: In the file, our recommended retail price including VAT is the selling price and your purchase price excluding VAT is the cost price. You can then adjust the selling price in your own store.
Installeer de app Matrixify uit de Shopi: Install the Matrixify app from the Shopify App Store. You need at least the Basic plan (about $20 per month); with it Matrixify can keep updating the products automatically.
Installeer de plugin WP All Import Pro m: Install the WP All Import Pro plugin with the WooCommerce add-on. You need the Professional package (about $299 per year); the free version cannot read a link.
Je API-sleutel: :key. Bewaar hem goed, w: Your API key: :key. Store it safely, we cannot show it again.
Kant-en-klare productbestanden voor een: Ready-made product files for a store on one of these two platforms: Shopify (Matrixify) :shopify and WooCommerce (WP All Import) :woocommerce
Kies \"WooCommerce Products\" en koppel: Choose "WooCommerce Products" and map the columns. For variations, choose "Linking multiple variations together" on the Parent SKU column.
Kies All Import, New Import, \"Download: Choose All Import, New Import, "Download a file", and paste this link: :url
Kies bij \"unique identifier\" de kolom: Under "unique identifier", choose the SKU column so a product is updated on the next import instead of being created twice.
Klik op Import. De eerste keer zet Matri: Click Import. The first time, Matrixify adds all products to your store; after that it only updates what has changed.
Kopieer hem nu: hij wordt niet opnieuw g: Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
Liever een bestand inlezen dan de API aa: Rather import a file than call the API? The entire assortment is also available as JSON (:json) and as XML (:xml). The same data, no key needed, updated every few hours.
Meer voorraad dan dit ziet de afnemer al: The reseller sees this number for any stock above it.
Met deze links zet de afnemer ons assort: With these links the reseller adds our assortment to their own store. The two CSV feeds are for Shopify and WooCommerce, the JSON and XML feeds are for a custom integration. Send them the instructions with the Send installation email button.
Nog niet, gebeurt bij de eerste ophaling: Not yet, happens on the first fetch
Ons assortiment in je eigen webshop: Our product range in your own webshop
Ophalingen van een Shopify- of WooCommer: Fetches of a Shopify or WooCommerce feed per IP address per minute. Default 60.
Per API-sleutel per minuut. Standaard 30: Per API key per minute. Default 300.
Schrijft de afnemer zijn eigen teksten o: If the reseller writes their own texts or uses their own images, turn off the relevant field. The column is then left out of the feeds, so their import tool does not overwrite their own work. The title is always included, because a new product needs one.
Shopify en WooCommerce koppelen op SKU o: Shopify and WooCommerce match on SKU or EAN. Without both, the product is created twice at the reseller.
Stel bij Scheduling een herhaling in, bi: Set a recurrence at Scheduling, for example every 4 hours.
Wij sturen een ondertekend bericht naar: We send a signed message to this address as soon as a product changes for this reseller or leaves their assortment. Leave empty to send no messages.
Zet \"Remove or modify records not prese: Turn on "Remove or modify records not present in this import file", only for this import, and choose "Change post status to draft". That way a product we no longer supply disappears from your store without losing the work you put into it.
Zet bij \"Schedule\" een herhaling, bijv: Set a repeat under "Schedule", for example every 4 hours. That way prices and stock in your store always match ours.
Zo lang ziet een afnemer via \"gewijzigd: This is how long a reseller still sees via "changed since" that a product is gone. An integration that fetches less often misses that notice. Default: 30 days.
